ValidationRule.description: Locks amount, payment method, and registration on completed payments to preserve accounting integrity.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Payment_Status__c), "Successful"), OR( ISCHANGED(Amount__c), ISCHANGED(Registration__c), ISCHANGED(Payment_Method__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Successful payments are locked and cannot have their amount, method, or registration modified.
